eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Mapped outline, terrain and present-day surroundings from open data. No historic reconstruction.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.

notes: site: osm:way/1033798953 historic=monument 216 m from ledger point
present-day buildings capped: kept the 120 nearest the outline centre of 507 mapped (trace size budget); the rest of the town is not drawn
roads capped: kept the 150 longest of 163 mapped (trace size budget); minor lanes are not drawn
origin moved 216 m from the ledger point to the centre of the mapped site
